title: Interior design prices in Kyiv: cost per m² and what each package includes
seo_title: Interior Design Prices in Kyiv: $6, $30, $45 per m² (2026)
description: Interior design cost in Kyiv: planning from $6/m², design project from $30/m² (min. $2 500), full with supervision from $45/m². What each package includes.
lead: Interior design in Kyiv costs from $6/m² for planning to $45/m² for a full project with designer supervision — the price depends on how much documentation you need. Design is priced per m², so we explain what each package includes and work out figures for 40, 80 and 120 m² apartments.

body: h2
What does the price of interior design depend on?
p

A design project is priced per square metre, but the rate depends on the scope of work, not on the "style". Some clients only need a good layout so they can run the renovation themselves. Others need a full set of drawings for the crew. Others also want the designer to accompany the renovation so that the result matches the visualisations.
p

That is why CAS Development has three standard packages. The scope can be tailored, but the packages show the order of figures at once and let you compare offers from different studios on the same set of documents. To commission a project and see what it includes and its stages, go to [interior design cost in Kyiv](/en/interior-design-cost); for a quick estimate for your area, use the [cost calculator](/en/renovation-cost-calculator?k=design#calc).
h2
How much does interior design in Kyiv cost per m²?
ul
Planning — from $6/m²: measured survey, 2–3 layout options, furniture layout, room schedule with areas.

Basic — from $30/m², minimum $2 500: everything in Planning, 3D visualisations of all rooms, working drawings (demolition and new walls, electrics, plumbing, ceilings, floors, tile layout), specifications of materials and furniture.

Full with designer supervision — from $45/m²: everything in Basic, elevations of all walls, bespoke furniture drawings, designer supervision during the renovation with visits on a schedule set in the contract, selection of furniture, lighting and decor.
p
More on the packages on the [interior design](/en/interior-design) page. Purchasing and delivery of furniture and materials are not part of the design price — that is a separate furnishing service.

h2
When is the planning package enough?
p

The planning package is enough for a simple renovation where you are ready to pick materials and furniture yourself but do not want to get the walls and zones wrong. A layout is the foundation of any interior: it decides where the kitchen, wardrobes and bed stand, how much storage there is and how people move around the flat.
p
What it lacks: visualisations and working drawings. The crew will have to make some decisions on its own — for example, where exactly to put sockets or how to lay the tiles.
h2
What is in the basic design package?
p

The basic package is a full design project: you see the interior in 3D before the renovation starts, and the crew gets dimensioned drawings. The renovation estimate is built from the working drawings and specifications, so the basic project also tells you the budget in advance, not just how the flat will look.
p
The minimum price of a design project is $2 500, so for small apartments the total is set by that minimum rather than the per-metre rate.
h2
Why designer supervision in the full package?
p

Designer supervision keeps the renovation true to the project: even the best drawings do not guarantee the result if nobody checks the work against them. Designer supervision means regular site visits on a schedule in the contract: the designer answers the crew's questions, checks that the work matches the drawings and helps when something has to change on site.
p

The full package also includes elevations of all walls, bespoke furniture drawings and selection of furniture, lighting and decor. If another contractor does the renovation, supervision terms and cost are agreed individually — see [designer and technical supervision](/en/design-and-technical-supervision).

h2
Three packages in figures: 40, 80 and 120 m²
p
Below is a calculation at the studio's base rates. It is the lower bound: approximate, the exact figure comes from the estimate.
ul
40 m²: planning from 40 × $6 = $240; basic from $2 500 (40 × $30 = $1 200, the minimum applies); full 40 × $45 = $1 800 at the rate, but not less than the $2 500 design project minimum.
80 m²: planning from 80 × $6 = $480; basic from $2 500 (80 × $30 = $2 400, the minimum applies); full from 80 × $45 = $3 600.
120 m²: planning from 120 × $6 = $720; basic from 120 × $30 = $3 600; full from 120 × $45 = $5 400.
p

The total depends on the number of rooms, the complexity of the layout, the amount of bespoke furniture and the supervision schedule. A [worked example for an apartment](/en/blog/interior-design-cost-kyiv) of 50 to 150 m² is in a separate article.
h2
What else to budget for besides design?
ul
renovation — from $550/m²: works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are estimated separately
furnishing — from $250/m²
measurement on site — paid, the cost depends on the property
purchasing and delivery of furniture and decor, if needed as part of furnishing
h2
How CAS works
p

We create the design project, prepare the estimate and, if needed, run the renovation all the way to furniture. You have one manager, photo reports every 1–2 weeks and a 12-month warranty on works. If CAS carries out the renovation to our project, the total does not deviate from the estimate by more than ±5%. 10+ years and 150+ projects since 2016. A phone consultation is free: tell us about your apartment and we will suggest which package suits you.
